_what_this_is: Per-run usage summary for Experiment 1, computed from the raw records in data/runs/ - not transcribed from any report. Regenerate with `python3 data/usage_summary.py`.
_how_cost_is_imputed: The runs were made on a subscription, which does not bill per token. Dollar figures are IMPUTED: token counts read from the records, multiplied by the rate card frozen in frozen/pricing.json before the runs. `thinking` tokens are a subset of `out` and are reported separately for information only - they are NOT added to the cost a second time.

repeat_runs._what_this_is: Tasks that the same arm took to a verified-green result more than once. The attempts are NOT interchangeable - they straddle amendments A1, A2, A4 and A5, so the environment and the accounting changed between them. Read this as an upper bound on run-to-run spread, not as a clean repeatability measurement. It is published because any reader comparing the two arms needs to know how wide a single number can be.

session_ids._finding: The `session_ids` field is populated for arm A and is empty in EVERY arm-B record and EVERY arm-B session-end event, including runs that plainly did real work and spent real tokens. It is an instrument gap on one side, not a property of the runs. An empty list therefore does NOT by itself mean 'no session started' - for arm B it means nothing at all, and the adjudications that argued from it relied on the transcripts, not on this field.

context_rebuild._finding: `context_rebuild` is null in every record: the decomposition was never implemented, so it was done post-hoc from transcripts. Each record says so itself in `nie_umiem_zmierzyc`.
